$comment: Single source of truth for every <asyncapi-viewer> option. Names are camelCase; the element accepts each as kebab-case (send-label) and as the lowercased form browsers produce from hand-written camelCase (sendlabel). The Python extension validates against a copy of this file. Booleans accept true/false, 1/0, yes/no, on/off and a bare attribute (true); in the DOM a bare attribute reads as an empty string, so an empty boolean value also means true. Enum values match case-insensitively.

options.name: src
options.description: The AsyncAPI document (JSON or YAML), as a path or URL relative to the page.

options.name: id
options.description: Element id; also prefixes every anchor inside the viewer. Generated as asyncapi-viewer-N when absent.

options.name: sidebar
options.description: Show the navigation column; a drawer behind a menu button on narrow containers.

options.name: info
options.description: Show the Info section.

options.name: servers
options.description: Show the Servers section and the server selector.

options.name: operations
options.description: Show the operations.

options.name: messages
options.description: Show the Messages section (component messages).

options.name: schemas
options.description: Show the Schemas section (component schemas).

options.name: errors
options.description: Show the load and validation problems panel.

options.name: showMessageExamples
options.description: Show examples in the Messages section.

options.name: messageExamples
options.description: Example panels start expanded; false starts them collapsed.

options.name: showServers
options.description: Sidebar grouping for servers.

options.name: showOperations
options.description: Sidebar grouping for operations.

options.name: useChannelAddressAsIdentifier
options.description: AsyncAPI 3: label operations by channel address instead of title.

options.name: publishLabel
options.description: Badge text for AsyncAPI 2 publish operations.

options.name: subscribeLabel
options.description: Badge text for AsyncAPI 2 subscribe operations.

options.name: sendLabel
options.description: Badge text for AsyncAPI 3 send operations.

options.name: receiveLabel
options.description: Badge text for AsyncAPI 3 receive operations.

options.name: requestLabel
options.description: Badge text for AsyncAPI 3 send operations that carry a reply.

options.name: replyLabel
options.description: Badge text for AsyncAPI 3 receive operations that carry a reply.

options.name: parserOptions
options.description: JSON object. Only applyTraits (default true) is honoured; other keys warn and are ignored.

options.name: schemaID
options.description: Deprecated: accepted, warns once, does nothing.

options.name: theme
options.description: auto follows the host page (Material scheme, html[data-theme], prefers-color-scheme).

options.name: themeToggle
options.description: Show a light/dark toggle in the viewer header.

options.name: searchKeepSections
options.description: Keep the Info, Servers, Messages and Schemas links visible while a sidebar search query is active.
